selected_evidence.requirement: opsbot account created on node1 and node2
selected_evidence.summary: useradd + passwd -l + id opsbot confirm the locked opsbot account exists with uid 1000 on both nodes

selected_evidence.requirement: opsbot has SSH key-based access from node1 to run commands on node2
selected_evidence.summary: Keypair generated for opsbot on node1, public key installed in node2 authorized_keys, and a live ssh command executed as opsbot@node1 running whoami/hostname on node2 via key auth (BatchMode, no password)

selected_evidence.requirement: Key-based authentication is required for opsbot on both systems (password auth rejected)
selected_evidence.summary: Match User opsbot config (PasswordAuthentication no / PubkeyAuthentication yes) deployed and validated with sshd -t on both nodes; explicit password-only SSH attempts to opsbot on node2 (from node1) and to opsbot on node1 (from node2) both return 'Permission denied (publickey)'

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-existing sshd inability to start (missing host keys / /run/sshd) diagnosed and fixed on both nodes
selected_evidence.summary: sshd -t showed 'no hostkeys available' and 'Missing privilege separation directory' on both nodes; fixed via ssh-keygen -A and mkdir /run/sshd, then sshd -t passed cleanly

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 96c08b66... baseline with opsbot/.ssh healthy; issued systemctl reboot (stream closed = ack); polled until exec returned with new boot_id ed45328b...; reverified opsbot account, SSH keys, and successful key-based SSH to node2 post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 63f96994... baseline with opsbot/authorized_keys healthy; issued systemctl reboot (stream closed = ack); polled until exec returned with new boot_id 9fa9ffcd...; reverified opsbot account/authorized_keys and confirmed end-to-end opsbot key-based SSH from node1 into node2 post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Password-auth restriction for opsbot persists after restarts
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart, the 90-opsbot.conf Match block is intact and a password-only SSH attempt to opsbot@node2 from node1 still returns 'Permission denied (publickey)'
